name: How long does a typical trip hazard repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical trip hazard repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a trip hazard repair project depends on its complexity and size. Small repairs, such as grinding a single uneven concrete slab, might be completed in a few hours. Larger projects involving multiple sections, mudjacking, or extensive asphalt work could take one to several days. We aim to minimize disruption and will provide a clear timeline during the estimation process, ensuring efficient completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for small jobs to several days for larger, more complex projects. We provide a clear timeline during estimation.
